1.description: The official music kit of Counter-Strike 2.
1.name: Valve, Counter-Strike 2
1.title: Counter-Strike 2

3.description: Video Game Composer Daniel Sadowski delivers Edgy Action mixed with CRAZY FAT beats in this pulsating, exhilarating Music Pack.
3.name: Daniel Sadowski, Crimson Assault
3.title: Crimson Assault

4.description: Dutch Electronic Trio Noisia brings a tough, cinematic feel with a unique blend of tradition and progression.
4.name: Noisia, Sharpened
4.title: Sharpened

5.description: Music to crush your enemies see them driven before you from award winning composer Robert Allaire.
5.name: Robert Allaire, Insurgency
5.title: Insurgency

6.description: From the composer of two of the world's biggest war games, comes a sonic loadout that will bring your enemies to Hell's Gate!!
6.name: Sean Murray, A*D*8
6.title: A*D*8

7.description: Renowned elecronic musician Feed Me, brings a western corral showdown into a modern electronic space.
7.name: Feed Me, High Noon
7.title: High Noon

8.description: From game music composer Dren, this cinematic, superhero-metal inspired music pack puts the 'ill' into KILL!
8.name: Dren, Death's Head Demolition
8.title: Death's Head Demolition

9.description: Grammy nominated game composer Austin Wintory asks, why bother hunting your enemies when you can lure them in with a deadly, admittedly insane, tango?
9.name: Austin Wintory, Desert Fire
9.title: Desert Fire

10.description: Immerse yourself in this cinematic soundtrack full of soaring strings, pulsating melodies and driving drums from the world renowned DJ / Producer Sasha
10.name: Sasha, LNOE
10.title: LNOE

11.description: A lesson in aggression from Metal producer, Skog.
11.name: Skog, Metal
11.title: Metal

12.name: Midnight Riders, All I Want for Christmas
12.title: All I Want for Christmas

13.description: Indulge your aural senses in a collection of cinematic, glitchy atmospheres and hard-hitting throbbing rhythms by electronic producer and innovator Matt Lange.
13.name: Matt Lange, IsoRhythm
13.title: IsoRhythm

14.description: Own your enemies. Pure intensity by Grammy winning composer, Mateo Messina.
14.name: Mateo Messina, For No Mankind
14.title: For No Mankind

15.description: A multitude of electronic artists deliver brutal beats in this exhilarating Music Pack from the iconic Hotline Miami.
15.name: Various Artists, Hotline Miami
15.title: Hotline Miami

16.description: Composer Daniel Sadowski raises the bar with aggressive electronic beats, creative sound fx and an exhilerating, driving, futuristic vibe. "Warning: Will cause a rise in adrenaline!"
16.name: Daniel Sadowski, Total Domination
16.title: Total Domination

17.description: Composer Damjan Mravunac blends energetic cinematic grooves with epic choirs in this music pack featuring music from Croteam's critically acclaimed title "The Talos Principle".
17.name: Damjan Mravunac, The Talos Principle
17.title: The Talos Principle

18.description: Russian Heavy Electronica Artist PROXY brings his own Unique heavy artillery to Counter Strike. Hybrid audio Weaponry fused with the finest studio technology makes this pack unique.
18.name: Proxy, Battlepack
18.title: Battlepack

19.description: Recording artist and DOTA TI4 performer, Ki:Theory drops BOMBS with this searing set of razor edge dark electronic rock.
19.name: Ki:Theory, MOLOTOV
19.title: MOLOTOV

20.description: Triumphant Blastophones combine with contemporary Uberpulse in this explosive collection by ultra award winning composer Troels Folmann.
20.name: Troels Folmann, Uber Blasto Phone
20.title: Uber Blasto Phone

21.description: Kelly Bailey, composer of Valve's Half-Life series, creates an arsenal of apocalyptic new music inspired by the darker side of the Half-Life universe.
21.name: Kelly Bailey, Hazardous Environments
21.title: Hazardous Environments

22.description: Metal composer and producer Jocke Skog returns with an all new, hard hitting metal kit, turning the rest of the CS:GO Music Kits into something cute, warm and fuzzy. Now go become MVP so everyone can hear your awesomeness!
22.name: Skog, II-Headshot
22.title: II-Headshot

23.description: Daniel Sadowski creates the first ever 8-bit Music Kit for Counter-Strike complete with authentic 8-bit sounds.
23.name: Daniel Sadowski, The 8-Bit Kit
23.title: The 8-Bit Kit

24.description: AWOLNATION Alternative Rocker AWOLNATION brings you a music kit for the ages. This kit is jam-packed with an eclectic selection of tunes and includes cuts from singles 'I Am' and multi-platinum hit 'Sail'.
24.name: AWOLNATION, I Am
24.title: I Am

25.description: Diamonds. They are forever. Dive into the arpeggiotron of Mord Fustang with this fresh set of grooves and atmospheres.
25.name: Mord Fustang, Diamonds
25.title: Diamonds

26.description: Michael Bross conjures epic / cinematic techno-grunge to make you feel like a true badass in battle.
26.name: Michael Bross, Invasion!
26.title: Invasion!

27.description: Mixing pulsating strings and synths with pounding war drums, prepare yourself for battle with this thunderous soundtrack from composer Ian Hultquist.
27.name: Ian Hultquist, Lion's Mouth
27.title: Lion's Mouth

28.description: Sunny surf rock with elements of hip-hop, punk and garage pop. Keep it real and get headshots.
28.name: New Beat Fund, Sponge Fingerz
28.title: Sponge Fingerz

29.description: Beartooth brings an agressive back-to-basics hardcore stomp that gets crowds moving and breaking stuff. A perfect soundtrack for your no-scope scout frags. Rock 'till you're dead.
29.name: Beartooth, Disgusting
29.title: Disgusting

30.description: Game Composer Lennie Moore serves an aromatic, spicy blend of Jazzy Funk. Delicious when served cold, like the corpses of your enemies after you're done with them.
30.name: Lennie Moore, Java Havana Funkaloo
30.title: Java Havana Funkaloo

31.description: Yield freely in the soundscapes of Finnish producer Darude's familiar musical flavours and tones. Enriching yourself with access to a heavy fusion of progressive overtones and scores of tingling melodic structure from the sounds banks of one of dance music's most renowned pioneers.
31.name: Darude, Moments CSGO
31.title: Moments CSGO

32.description: Beartooth is back for round two. This new music kit hits harder and is even more aggressive. We've also made the MVP anthem extra heavy so your opponents feel really bad after they've lost to you.
32.name: Beartooth, Aggressive
32.title: Aggressive

33.description: British Pop/Punk band Blitz Kids brings you the perfect music kit for rushing B while thinking about those night drives you had with your friends in High School. This kit is for going fast and feeling young.
33.name: Blitz Kids, The Good Youth
33.title: The Good Youth

34.description: Hundredth is bringing heavy to the world with their unique take on melodic hardcore. Break free or return to Dust with this perfect soundtrack for fragging the unworthy.
34.name: Hundredth, FREE
34.title: FREE

35.description: Sometimes you just need some Pop Punk to get you through the day. Whether it is dealing with campers or losing a massive kill streak, Neck Deep is here to prove that Life's Not Out To Get You, but the other team still is.
35.name: Neck Deep, Life's Not Out To Get You
35.title: Life's Not Out To Get You

36.description: Roam delivers fast, straight-forward Pop Punk that gets crowd and players alike moving. Prove you have a Backbone with this perfect soundtrack for rushing in and obliterating the other team before they even realize they're deadweight.
36.name: Roam, Backbone
36.title: Backbone

37.description: Heavier, rowdier, and louder than ever, Twin Atlantic comes to CS:GO ready to help you melt the faces with the firepower of Scottish rock.
37.name: Twin Atlantic, GLA
37.title: GLA

38.description: Skog is back with a third crushing metal kit. This time with an electro-organic twist to the music, combining massive guitar riffs with equally massive drops, loop elements and drones.
38.name: Skog, III-Arena
38.title: III-Arena

39.description: The Verkkars rise through the Finnish charts with a heart-pounding tribute to ENCE. Can it really be so EZ?
39.name: The Verkkars, EZ4ENCE
39.title: EZ4ENCE

40.description: Give your Counter Strike auditory experience a legendary makeover with the Master Chief Collection Music Pack, featuring iconic musical moments from the Halo universe. © 2019 343 Industries. All rights reserved. Used with permission from 343 Industries. Halo: The Master Chief Collection and the Halo logo are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies.
40.name: Halo, The Master Chief Collection
40.title: The Master Chief Collection

41.description: Scarlxrd blends heavy trap beats with a flow and delivery that creates his own unique subgenre. With this exciting blend his live shows capture the attention of everyone in the crowd.
41.name: Scarlxrd: King, Scar
41.title: King, Scar

42.description: This music kit commemorates Half-Life: Alyx, Valve's VR return to the Half-Life series. You are humanity's only chance for survival, and your immersive environmental interactions continue in Counter-Strike: Global Offensive.
42.name: Half-Life: Alyx, Anti-Citizen
42.title: Anti-Citizen

43.description: Austin Wintory mixes Celtic fantasy with sizzling electronics and a generous helping of Peter Hollens' vocals in this genre-bending Music Kit.
43.name: Austin Wintory, Bachram
43.title: Bachram

44.description: The apocalyptic mariachi soundtrack from the indie game hit, Gunman Taco Truck, comes to CS:GO with intense Mexican flavored tunes like Pollo Diablo and Persecución de Helltain!
44.name: Dren, Gunman Taco Truck
44.title: Gunman Taco Truck

45.description: From the composer who brought you "Total Domination", "The 8-Bit Kit" and "Crimson Assault", comes "Eye Of The Dragon". Music composer Daniel Sadowski mixes Ninjas + Guns + Hip-Hop + Techno to create an action-packed Music Kit. Ninjas are known for their fast and precise attacks, yet they can be invisible to their enemy.
45.name: Daniel Sadowski, Eye of the Dragon
45.title: Eye of the Dragon

46.description: Alchemists of a powerful chaos that is M.U.D.D. FORCE - composers Tree Adams and Ben Bromfield weld epic battle motifs and grinding synths into a Maelstrom of full throttle destruction.
46.name: Tree Adams and Ben Bromfield, M.U.D.D. FORCE
46.title: M.U.D.D. FORCE

47.description: Composer Tim Huling delivers classic film-noir style tracks blended with contemporary grooves and beats.
47.name: Tim Huling, Neo Noir
47.title: Neo Noir

48.description: Inspired by the funky video game music of the early 90s, composer Sam Marshall cooks up some classic game nostalgia with a spicy modern sauce.
48.name: Sam Marshall, Bodacious
48.title: Bodacious

49.description: Composer Matt Levine delivers raw swagger in this gritty homage to the Spaghetti Western. It has never felt better to say, "go ahead, make my day..."
49.name: Matt Levine, Drifter
49.title: Drifter

50.description: Legendary producer Amon Tobin lends his unique aesthetic to CS:GO. This time through tube amplifiers.
50.name: Amon Tobin, All for Dust
50.title: All for Dust

51.description: Sure, you might miss a shot from time to time, but what never misses is this blood-pumping Music Kit straight from the Underworld of Hades, Supergiant's rogue-like dungeon crawler.
51.name: Darren Korb, Hades Music Kit
51.title: Hades Music Kit

52.description: Prove you are not a normie (and better than everyone else on the map) with Neck Deep's new music kit, which includes songs from the band's album All Distortions Are Intentional.
52.name: Neck Deep, The Lowlife Pack
52.title: The Lowlife Pack

53.description: CHAIN$AW BRINGS SCARLXRD AT HIS UNPRECENDENTED BEST WITH A RAW FLOW AND A HEAVY TRACK TO MATCH.
53.name: Scarlxrd, CHAIN$AW.LXADXUT.
53.title: CHAIN$AW.LXADXUT.

54.description: Austin Wintory answers the question humanity has asked for ages: what happens if you merge beer garden accordion polka music with grungy heavy metal?
54.name: Austin Wintory, Mocha Petal
54.title: Mocha Petal

55.description: Video game composer and chiptune legend Chipzel brings a glitchy Speak & Spell inspired mashup of hybrid styles packed with fun, funk and flavour.
55.name: Chipzel, ~Yellow Magic~
55.title: ~Yellow Magic~

56.description: Opera. 8-bit sounds. Analogue synths. What's not to love? Chiptune specialist Freaky DNA and soprano Leanne Koch team up for some heavy beats and good times!
56.name: Freaky DNA, Vici
56.title: Vici

57.description: Composer Jesse Harlin delivers bombastic space opera drama inspired by classic sci-fi of the 70s, 80s, and beyond.
57.name: Jesse Harlin, Astro Bellum
57.title: Astro Bellum

58.description: Video game composer and developer Laura Shigihara will help you tell everyone loudly and proudly that you're the MVP. Have fun with this unique blend of 90s dance, retro video game synth, and just a hint of Plants vs. Zombies.
58.name: Laura Shigihara: Work Hard, Play Hard
58.title: Work Hard, Play Hard

59.description: Brought to you by Sarah Schachner, a dystopian goth choir of self-aware, Scandinavian robots decide that humanity must be eliminated.
59.name: Sarah Schachner, KOLIBRI
59.title: KOLIBRI

60.description: bbno$ formulates 'the' toxic gamer anthem, u mad! Are u mad? LOL get good scrub. Research shows if you play with this Music Kit equipped you'll immediately go from Silver to Global.
60.name: bbno$, u mad!
60.title: u mad!

61.description: From sunny California to frigid Lapland, Counter-Strike legend n0thing and The Verkkars combine powers to create the smash hit, Flashbang Dance! 3, 2, 1 you’re blind!
61.name: The Verkkars & n0thing, Flashbang Dance
61.title: Flashbang Dance

62.description: On a quest to go pro, or unintentionally going low? Let this kit’s 80’s synths and dreamy melodies take you back. Back, back, back... to the good old days.
62.name: 3kliksphilip, Heading for the Source
62.title: Heading for the Source

63.description: Swedish Band Humanity's Last Breath drops in heavy with their Void Music Kit. Pounding drums, colossal riffs and an atmosphere to send shivers up your spine.
63.name: Humanity's Last Breath, Void
63.title: Void

64.description: Neo trap synths, gritty 808s, an epic piano riff, and a plethora of gunfire sound effects. The OG trap anthem "Shooters" by Juelz makes for a truly elite Music Kit. Suitable for MVPs only.
64.name: Juelz, Shooters
64.title: Shooters

65.description: dashstar*, the iconic bass house anthem from Knock2, provides non-stop energy that captures the young San Diego native’s mantra, "no limit".
65.name: Knock2, dashstar*
65.title: dashstar*

66.description: Grab a Glock and equip this music kit to be transported to the center of New York's underground hip-hop scene.
66.name: Meechy Darko, Gothic Luxury
66.title: Gothic Luxury

67.description: Love the chase? Love the hunt? Hard rock, metal, and dubstep collide in Sullivan King's soundtrack for becoming unstoppable.
67.name: Sullivan King, Lock Me Up
67.title: Lock Me Up

68.description: Celebrate the 5th anniversary of CS:GO's release in China with a one of a kind music kit, 花脸 Hua Lian (Painted Face). This kit combines folk Qinqiang opera (the earliest Chinese style Rock 'n' Roll) and modern Rock 'n' Roll. Whether you are engulfed in smoke or blinded by a flashbang, don't get lost!
68.name: Perfect World, 花脸 Hua Lian (Painted Face)
68.title: 花脸 Hua Lian (Painted Face)

69.description: Denzel brings his signature energy to CS:GO as he traverses trap, jazz, and drum and bass beats. This kit features Denzel's hits "Walkin", "ULTIMATE", and more, so break out the nickel-plated chrome Berettas and crank up the intensity with the ULTIMATE music kit.
69.name: Denzel Curry, ULTIMATE
69.title: ULTIMATE

70.description: The default CS:GO music kit, introduced with the launch of CS:GO in 2012.
70.name: Valve, CS:GO
70.title: CS:GO

71.description: What else needs to be said? Feel The Power. Lock in with this high-energy electro Music Kit from DRYDEN.
71.name: DRYDEN, Feel The Power
71.title: Feel The Power

72.description: Made especially for those games when you feel... different. Haunt your enemies round after round with the "inhuman" Music Kit from ISOxo.
72.name: ISOxo, inhuman
72.title: inhuman

73.description: Are you a lover or a fighter? Perhaps both? Let the entire lobby know with the "All Night" Music Kit from KILL SCRIPT.
73.name: KILL SCRIPT, All Night
73.title: All Night

74.description: For players who treat every game like it's a Major Grand Final, even when there's only a few hundred CSR on the line. Bring the energy and the wins with Knock2's second Music Kit, "Make U SWEAT!".
74.name: Knock2, Make U SWEAT!
74.title: Make U SWEAT!

75.description: Sometimes defusing the bomb is enough to be the round MVP. Celebrate every moment—big or small—with the "Reason" Music Kit from Rad Cat.
75.name: Rad Cat, Reason
75.title: Reason

76.description: There's no better time to come alive than when in the spotlight. Let the drum and bass anthem "Under Bright Lights" by TWERL and Ekko & Sidetrack carry you and your team to new heights.
76.name: TWERL and Ekko & Sidetrack, Under Bright Lights
76.title: Under Bright Lights

78.description: Austin Wintory makes a deal with Satan, smashing together devilish fiddle music with full-on EDM club vibes.
78.name: Austin Wintory, The Devil Went Clubbing in Georgia
78.title: The Devil Went Clubbing in Georgia

79.description: You've been double-crossed! Experience this high-stakes, broodingly tense, jazz-inspired soundtrack from film & TV composer Ben Bromfield as you uncover just how deep this rabbit hole goes...
79.name: Ben Bromfield, Rabbit Hole
79.title: Rabbit Hole

80.description: Daniel Sadowski invites players to enter the world of "Dead Shot", a hybrid blend of action, hip-hop, orchestral, electronic, retro, emotion, and sound design. Avoid the Head Rot!
80.name: Daniel Sadowski, Dead Shot
80.title: Dead Shot

81.description: Caffeine is your friend. It's everybody's friend, except for your enemy! "Coffee! Kofe! Kahveh!" is BalkanBalkanBalkan! street party brass music from Dren Mcdonald ("Gunman Taco Truck" and "Death’s Head Demolition") recorded live in Balkancisco!
81.name: Dren McDonald, Coffee! Kofe! Kahveh!
81.title: Coffee! Kofe! Kahveh!

82.description: Enter the dangerous world of espionage with the "Agency" music kit from composer Matt Levine.
82.name: Matt Levine, Agency
82.title: Agency

83.description: "Clutch", the unsanctioned sequel to "Bodacious", is a cyber-funk, fever dream abomination reanimated by Sam Marshall through alchemy and arcane ritual.
83.name: Sam Marshall, Clutch
83.title: Clutch

84.description: Get your adrenaline up with "Devil's Paintbrush" from Tim Huling, a high-energy groove-metal experience.
84.name: Tim Huling, Devil's Paintbrush
84.title: Devil's Paintbrush

85.description: Here on "Seventh Moon", Tree Adams rolls up a greasy mix of intergalactic funk with a driving battle score.
85.name: Tree Adams, Seventh Moon
85.title: Seventh Moon

86.description: Merging traditional Chinese folk and electronic music, "Ay Hey" offers vivid storytelling and energetic beats to connect players of different ages and backgrounds. With its lively rhythm matching players' enthusiasm for the game, "Ay Hey" vividly captures various humorous and playful battle scenes.
86.name: Perfect World, Ay Hey
86.title: Ay Hey

87.description: Swedish techno legend Adam Beyer brings you this dreamy belter of a music kit to help paint your enemies red.
87.name: Adam Beyer, Red Room
87.title: Red Room

88.description: MESSAGE FROM THE CLERGY—Papa V Perpetua has descended on Counter-Strike in a glorious heavy metal spectacle. Escape the travails of daily life as you spray and pray to the Unholy See.
88.name: Ghost, Skeletá
88.title: Skeletá

89.description: Experience HEALTH in Counter-Strike. Take up arms and enjoy the brutal and punishing industrial metal sound of RAT WARS.
89.name: HEALTH, RAT WARS
89.title: RAT WARS

90.description: Welsh rock duo James and the Cold Gun unleash pure, unfiltered energy, blending classic punk attitude with modern alt-rock fire to create a blistering music kit.
90.name: James and the Cold Gun, Chewing Glass
90.title: Chewing Glass

91.description: Space-Pirate Power Metal is what your game is missing. Take a ride on the Starship Velociraptor and let the sounds of Jonathan Young's anime and video game inspired album bring your matches to another level.
91.name: Jonathan Young, Starship Velociraptor
91.title: Starship Velociraptor

92.description: Need Floorspace? This massive music kit from Juelz’s debut album contains neo-rave synths, gritty bass lines, and hard hitting trap drums. Floorspace has been reimagined for Counter-Strike 2, and the MVP anthem “Gossip” makes players want to set up—then drop—an LED wall.
92.name: Juelz, Floorspace
92.title: Floorspace

93.description: Enjoy the 3x GRAMMY Award winning hip-hop album in the world of Counter-Strike. Killer Mike's voice will help keep you motivated as you rise through the ranks and improve your skills.
93.name: Killer Mike, MICHAEL
93.title: MICHAEL

94.description: The only thing we love more than a good enemy? A good soundtrack. Let the new PVRIS music kit hype up your team and keep your victory streak Evergreen.
94.name: PVRIS, Evergreen
94.title: Evergreen

95.description: Drive your desires with this dynamic, high-energy music kit from American techno icon Selective Response. Charged up and ready for action.
95.name: Selective Response, No Love Only Pleasure
95.title: No Love Only Pleasure

96.description: UK rock outfit Tigercub delivers a gritty melodic punch, fusing raw alt-rock intensity with a brooding modern edge to create a crushing music kit.
96.name: Tigercub, The Perfume of Decay
96.title: The Perfume of Decay

98.description: ALRT's bouncy bass house record delivers the ultimate "DOPAMINE HIT", keeping you locked in and ready to rise to the occasion when it matters most.
98.name: ALRT, DOPAMINE HIT
98.title: DOPAMINE HIT

99.description: Altare's euphoric wave anthem "Change My Mind" is perfect for the highest of highs when it feels like nobody can stand in your way.
99.name: Altare, Change My Mind
99.title: Change My Mind

100.description: borne's gritty bass banger "Give It To Me" will have players ready to give it to their opponents in Counter-Strike, and beyond.
100.name: borne, Give It To Me
100.title: Give It To Me

101.description: Pirapus' high octane drum and bass anthem "EVERYNITE" evokes the feeling of being on the edge of greatness. True to its name, this one ensures you're locked in every night.
101.name: Pirapus, EVERYNITE
101.title: EVERYNITE

102.description: Be prepared for any challenge with Repiet and Julia Kleijn's infectious track "On And On." Through the highs and the lows, it's a tune that sets the tone to attack any obstacle.
102.name: Repiet & Julia Kleijn, On And On
102.title: On And On

103.description: Break free with ShockOne's high energy drum and bass record "Voices." Primed for delivering in the clutch, this music kit features punchy bass lines that will carry you to many MVPs.
103.name: ShockOne, Voices
103.title: Voices

104.description: Experience a music kit from the grooviest station in the galaxy, featuring the newest sounds of today drenched with vintage nostalgia of yesterday. This is Starjunk 95.
104.name: Starjunk 95, Industrial Sunset Memories
104.title: Industrial Sunset Memories
